module: Humorous vehicle "eyes" auxiliary controller: enlarges or shrinks tagged beams (eye beams, limiters, attachments) according to the vertical acceleration (sensors.gz) to make the eyes bulge; they are at maximum size at ignition 3 (starter).
notes: jbeam keys read: eyeBeamTag ("eyeBeam"), eyeLimiterBeamTag ("eyeLimiterBeam"), eyeAttachmentBeamTag ("eyeAttachmentBeam"); maxSizeCoef (1), minSizeCoef (1), minSizeBoundCoef (1), maxSizeBoundCoef (1), attachmentMinSizeCoef (1), attachmentMaxSizeCoef (1), sizeSmoothingShrink (5), sizeSmoothingGrow (5), gravityMaxSizeCoef (1).
The beams are found via beamstate.tagBeamMap[tag]; their length is modified by obj:setBeamLength and the long bound of the limiter beams by obj:setBoundedBeamLongBound.

Pitfall: sizeSmoothingShrink is passed as the first argument ("in" rate) of the smoother and sizeSmoothingGrow as the second ("out"): their roles depend on the newTemporalSmoothingNonLinear convention.
All coefficients are 1 by default: without configuration the controller changes nothing.

init.desc: Finds the beams by tag, stores their rest lengths and reads the jbeam coefficients.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: computes the size coefficient according to sensors.gz and adjusts the beam lengths and bounds.
